landing.eyebrow: AI-POWERED UNDERGROUND COAL MINE SAFETY & RESCUE
landing.subtitle: MINE OPERATIONS & LIFE-SAVING EXPLORER
landing.description: An operations system for underground coal mines. M.O.L.E. brings mine mapping, daily worker deployment, environmental monitoring, remote rover operations, survivor detection and emergency rescue coordination into a single control-room console.

SITE_MANAGER.label: SITE MANAGER
SITE_MANAGER.description: Configures the mine, its layout and monitoring setup.

RESCUE_OPERATOR.label: RESCUE OPERATOR
RESCUE_OPERATOR.description: Runs the rover and rescue console during an emergency.

mapping.title: UNDERGROUND MINE MAPPING
mapping.description: Keep an up-to-date layout of galleries, shafts and junctions.

workers.title: DAILY WORKER DEPLOYMENT
workers.description: Record which personnel are deployed to which underground areas each shift.

environment.title: ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING
environment.description: Watch methane, CO, oxygen, temperature and water-ingress readings.

rover.title: REMOTE ROVER OPERATIONS
rover.description: Drive the rescue rover from the surface with camera, LiDAR and drill controls.

survivors.title: SURVIVOR DETECTION
survivors.description: Flag possible survivors from thermal and vital-sign cues.

rescue.title: EMERGENCY RESCUE COORDINATION
rescue.description: Coordinate hazards, rescue targets and missions during an incident.
